{"body":"**Severity: MEDIUM** (design-contract; spec-conformant as-is). From the retro `/crypto-privacy-review` of #676 (IPNS/pointer/mailbox payloads).

`crates/core/src/payload/mailbox.rs:60-67` (`sig_preimage`) / `:125-148` (`verify_inner`): the sender signs over `[MAILBOX_SIG_DOMAIN, v, senderIdentityPk, payload]` only — the inner signed blob is **recipient-agnostic**. A malicious recipient R1 who HPKE-opens an item can lift the inner `{payload, senderIdentityPk, senderSig}` and re-HPKE-seal it to R2; R2's `open_mailbox_payload` verifies the sender signature successfully and concludes the sender authored that payload "to them." The untrusted API alone cannot do this (it can't open R1's blob), so the attacker must be a malicious recipient — which bounds impact.

This **matches the frozen spec** (#39 D9 / `blueprint/core.md` "Pointer payloads — Mailbox"), which deliberately binds only domain/version/senderKey. This issue is to make the contract explicit and enforced at the layer that owns mailbox semantics:

- **Confirm/enforce:** no higher-layer mailbox payload semantics may treat "I received a validly-signed item" as "the sender addressed this item to me" — anything action-triggering or grant-related must carry its own recipient binding inside `payload`.
- If recipient-binding is ever desired at the core layer, it belongs in the sig preimage.
- Add the cross-recipient relay KAT (tracked with the KAT-gap issue) to freeze the current property as intended.
","labels":["v2-build"],"state":"CLOSED","title":"core/engine: mailbox sender signature is recipient-agnostic — enforce the no-implicit-addressing contract [MEDIUM]"}

{"body":"Consolidated non-blocking **simplify + minor-hardening** backlog from the retro `/simplify` + `/security-review` sweep of the shipped v2 PRs. Each item is safe/non-behavioral unless noted. Grouped by area.

## API — concurrency helpers
- [ ] Registry `lockGuardedTransaction` (`registry.service.ts:98-109`) duplicates the shared `runLockGuardedTransaction` byte-for-byte — replace both call sites + drop the now-unused `isLockNotAvailable` import. (Flagged by the #677, #688, and #693 reviews.)
- [ ] Mailbox `recipientLockKey` (`mailbox.service.ts:265`) reimplements `advisoryLockKey` and is **unnamespaced** — use `advisoryLockKey('mailbox:' + recipientPublicKey)` (dedup + follow the key-namespacing discipline the other services use).
- [ ] Mailbox `enforceCapAndInsert` uses raw `dataSource.transaction` — a later row-lock `55P03` (its `purgeExpired` DELETE vs a concurrent `poll`/`ack`) escapes as **500 not 503**; wrap in `runLockGuardedTransaction` like the sibling services (#683 S1 / #688 nit). Note: correctness of all three services depends on READ COMMITTED isolation, which none pin (#683 S2) — worth an explicit note or assertion.
- [ ] Registry `register` writes are **N+1** (`nameRepo.save`/`pinRepo.save` on arrays) under held locks — `pinWrites` are all-new, so `pinRepo.insert(pinWrites)` is one multi-row INSERT (the repo's own "#677: bulk not N+1" lesson); O(n²) retire dedup → `Set`.
- [ ] Content (#695): add a `boundedAcquire(manager, keys, timeoutMs)` helper (the `setAdvisoryLockTimeout`+`acquireAdvisoryLocks` pair, 3 call sites); trim the session-lock invariant comment (stated ~3×, keep the class doc); drop the always-equal `RegisterOutcome.cid`; drop the unread `KuboAddResult.Size`.

## Engine
- [ ] #692: `fanout_get_verify` returns `(sequence, bytes)` then discards the `VerifiedRecord` it built — return `(VerifiedRecord, bytes)` so `eol_republish` (`net/liveness.rs:111`) and `publish.rs` stop **re-parsing + re-verifying (Ed25519)** the same bytes. Removes a signature verify per renewal.
- [ ] #682: drop the redundant `floor::sequence_floor` pass-through wrapper (or route all floor reads through the `floor::*` wrappers consistently); hoist a constant-time `ct_eq` onto core's `SecretBytes` so the engine composes it instead of the engine-local `ct_eq_secret` (AGENTS rule 4 — crypto lives in core).
- [ ] #671: remove dead `ApiError::NotAuthenticated` + unused `ChallengeResponse.expires_at`; optional `post_json_authed<B: Serialize>(path, &B)` helper for the repeated serialize+content-type endpoint boilerplate.
- [ ] #690: `commit_floors` returns a `Vec<u64>` no production caller consumes (borderline — conformance-symmetry with the single-key methods; confirm intent); trim within-file doc overlap.
- [ ] #676: `IpnsRecord::Drop` zeroizes public (published-to-IPFS) data — remove the `Drop` impl (or at least the weak-apologia comment).

## Core
- [ ] #664: hoist the triplicated `hex_lower` `Debug` formatter (`ecdsa`/`ed25519`/`x25519`) to one shared helper.
- [ ] #675: a `SecretField` newtype/macro for the repeated redacted-`Debug` + non-ct-`PartialEq` boilerplate across the grant payload types.

## Web
- [ ] #670: hoist the memoized `open()` block duplicated verbatim across `floorStore`/`snapshotCache`/`stagingStore` into `idb.ts`; the body-copy-for-TS clones (`http.ts:31`, `recordTransport.ts:49`) can use a `BufferSource` cast to avoid allocating.
","labels":["v2-build"],"state":"OPEN","title":"chore: retro-audit simplify + hardening backlog (shipped v2 PRs)"}
